descriptionChirho: The temporal starting point or origin of something, often used of the creation (ἐν ἀρχῇ) or the onset of an era, ministry, or experience.
A supernatural or political authority figure, often plural (ἀρχαί) referring to angelic or demonic powers in the cosmic hierarchy.
The abstract sphere, office, or power of ruling; dominion or position of authority held by a ruler or supernatural being.
The corner or outermost edge of a physical object such as a sheet or sail, as in the vision of Acts 10–11.
